title: Voidteleport
description: This is a plugin where, if you fall into the void, you respawn at the set spawn point. It should work independently on each world.
body:
This is a plugin where, if you fall into the void, you respawn at the set spawn point. It should work independently on each world.
A player is falling into the endless Minecraft void, surrounded by floating islands and a dark atmosphere. A glowing spawn point above represents the return after falling.
